title: Russell takes over as leader; Simeon and Metcalf come in
summary: After the owner fired drummer George Howe, Russell led the band; Holmes kept leaving and returning while Simeon and Metcalf joined.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now, Russell's band at the Nest...
Well, just around this time, see... George Howe, he was the leader of the band when I went there. I think he was fired the first week I was there. The boss of the place fired him...
Oh, George Howe was the drummer.
He was the drummer. He was the leader. And the boss of the place fired George, I don't know what happened, and he made Luis Russell the leader of the band. So we're working for Russell now.
Well, we stayed there quite a while. And in the meantime, there were quite a few changes that went on in the band. And like I told you, I don't know the first time I
left him... That's when he got Simeon. I know Simeon replaced me in the Nest. Because I was leaving Russell all the time, going this place, that and the other one.

And Metcalf come in the band; he had been with Duke, and he come out of Duke's band. And I'm trying to think that if he comes down to the Nest... No, I don't think he was down there. I don't know when Metcalf come in, but I think it was... Maybe some other club, but it wasn't at the Nest. But when Metcalf did come in, he came in with some damn good ideas. And he was a good man, you know; a very good man. He had good ideas...
